messages.subject: lavaan for complex cause-effect relationship?
parts:
Dear researchers,

please suggest i want to use lavaan for complex cause-effect relationship, how can i perform analysis?

for example, at the one time, latent construct are endogenous, and on the other time these constructs are exogenous too.

i.e. 

    intentions =~ attitude + sn + pbc (intention also have own manifest variables)
    
    attitude =~ x1 + x2 + x3              (x1x2x3, own manifest variables)
    sn =~ x4 + x5                              (x4x5, own manifest variables)
    pbc =~ x6 + x7                            (x6x7, own manifest variables)

Now, attitude, sn and pbc are endogenous construct because these also have beliefs based factors to measures...

please recommend some literature to deal in lavaan.
